data.name: Jyaniksha
data.long_meaning: Jyaniksha is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words ‘jnana’ meaning knowledge and ‘iksha’ meaning inquisitive or insightful. This name is often given to girls who are believed to be deeply knowledgeable and inquisitive by nature. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning, is often invoked for the blessings of knowledge and wisdom.

in_sanskrit.name: ज्यानिक्षा
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who has the limit or end of knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
ज्यानि (Jyani) - knowledge
क्षा (Ksha) - limit or end
Therefore, Jyaniksha can be interpreted as 'One who has the limit or end of knowledge'.
